how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_018.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.merciless.des: Instantly kill weakened enemies or drain the life force of those who lack the will to fight or of those much weaker than you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mirage.descri: Create illusionary clones around the caster.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.molecular_man: Use your intricate knowledge and power over the building blocks of the world to obtain blocks and move entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mortal_fear.d: Inspire a gripping fear of death in weaker enemies while empowering your allies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mud_hand.desc: Bind targets with several hands of mud.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mud_spears.de: Raise mud spikes from the ground to pierce through your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.multilayer_ba: Protect yourself with a multitude of powerful defensive barriers.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.murderer.desc: Disappear into the shadows and deal massive damage, also become undetectable by sound.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.musician.desc: Turn beautiful music into an instrument of destruction. Use sound to create powerful blasts which ignore armor.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.observer.desc: See all, evade all. Instinctively avoid attacks, detect concealed dangers, and identify hidden entities. Nothing escapes your watchful gaze.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ogre_berserke: Allow rage to consume you to massively improve your physical powers for a time before the aftereffects set in.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ogre_flame.de: Use your aura to create a pillar of fire.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ogre_sword_ca: Condense your aura into a blade projectile.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ogre_sword_gu: Coat your weapon in aura enhancing its blows.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.oppressor.des: Dominate gravity yourself, control attractive and repulsive forces or unleash devastating ranged attacks which will crush anyone unfortunate enough to be in your path.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.paralysing_br: Spew a horrifying breath to paralyze your prey.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.paralysis.des: Empower your attacks with the effect of Paralysis, toggleable when mastered.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.paralysis_res: Ignore weaker paralysis effects or reduce the duration of stronger paralysis.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.physical_atta: Ignore weaker physical attacks or reduce the damage from stronger blows.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.pierce_resist: Ignore weaker piercing damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.poison.descri: Empower your attacks with the effect of Poison, toggleable when mastered.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.poison_resist: Ignore weaker poisons or reduce the damage from more potent toxins.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.poisonous_bre: Use your disgusting breath to corrode and nauseate your targets.
